annotations.title: Signed observation of a URL (paid, x402)

description: PAID: attest a URL: we fetch it and sign what we saw (hash, status, headers, never the body), timestamped. A failed fetch is still an observation. Unpaid, it returns the price; pay with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana) in _meta['x402/payment'] and call again. Feedback: POST /feedback (free). Read daily; no individual reply.

url.description: An absolute http:// or https:// URL, at most 2048 UTF-8 bytes. The body is never returned to you.
